targets.rawSql: WITH last_500 AS (SELECT issue_id FROM issue_funnel_stage_duration WHERE workspace_id = '$workspace_id' GROUP BY issue_id ORDER BY max(entered_at) DESC LIMIT 500) SELECT stage, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS p50_seconds, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS p95_seconds, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS p99_seconds FROM issue_funnel_stage_duration WHERE issue_id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM last_500) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage

SELECT entered_at AS time, stage AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM issue_funnel_stage_duration WHERE workspace_id = '$workspace_id' AND $__timeFilter(entered_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT issue_number, stage, entered_at, duration_seconds FROM issue_funnel_stage_duration WHERE workspace_id = '$workspace_id' AND is_open AND duration_seconds > 604800 ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC
SELECT stage, duration_seconds FROM issue_funnel_stage_duration WHERE workspace_id = '$workspace_id' AND $__timeFilter(entered_at)
